source_learning.fact: The latest Money Intelligence matched-control work strengthened a causal mechanism in which scheduled or compulsory capital flow can be real while headline flow estimates alone are poor timing predictors; implementation schedule, offsetting flows, free float, ownership constraints, liquidity/depth and prior positioning determine price impact.
source_learning.inference: For large-upside research, forced-flow intensity relative to available float and trading capacity is a more defensible precursor family than raw announced flow size.
source_learning.unknown: This mechanism has not yet been shown to predict <=90-day 2x outcomes in the Cohort 001 crypto universe.

hypotheses.claim: When a genuinely rules-based or contractually scheduled net-buying catalyst exists before the decision cutoff, larger expected net forced demand relative to PIT free-float market value is associated with higher <=90-day 2x incidence than matched controls, conditional on liquidity and prior positioning.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: precommitted buyer budget -> implementation schedule -> demand that is less price-elastic than ordinary discretionary flow -> finite free float / ownership headroom -> market impact -> reflexive attention and follow-on discretionary demand

feature_definition.name: forced_net_flow_to_free_float
feature_definition.numerator: PIT expected gross compulsory buying USD minus PIT expected compulsory selling/reweight offsets USD

eligible_catalysts: index/benchmark inclusion or weight change with published rules
contractually scheduled treasury/buyback purchase with documented size/timing
mechanical fund or wrapper allocation with documented target exposure
other predeclared price-insensitive flow only when the buyer mandate and budget are timestamp-defensible
excluded_narratives: social-media attention without a committed buyer budget
headline market-cap estimates treated as buying flow
post-outcome reconstruction of who must have bought
required_controls: same PIT cohort eligibility as Cohort 001
falsifiers: no lift over matched base rate after coverage-complete testing
effect disappears after conditioning on prior momentum/liquidity
apparent lift is driven by one event family or one asset
forced-flow estimate is not reproducible from information available at cutoff

hypotheses.claim: For the same eligible forced-flow events, expected net compulsory buying relative to pre-event trading capacity is more informative than the absolute announced flow amount.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: compulsory demand concentrated into limited implementation windows -> demand/available-liquidity imbalance -> temporary or persistent price impact depending offsetting supply and follow-on demand

feature_definition.name: forced_net_flow_to_implementation_liquidity
feature_definition.numerator: PIT expected net compulsory buying USD
feature_definition.denominator: PIT trailing-30d median daily venue quote volume USD multiplied by predeclared implementation trading days
feature_definition.implementation_days_rule: use the published implementation/tranche window known at cutoff; if not published, feature is UNKNOWN

timing_variables: prior return from announcement to decision
falsifiers: headline/absolute flow performs as well after matched controls
ratio has no stable ranking lift out of sample
price impact occurs entirely before the frozen decision point
liquidity denominator is not PIT or is dominated by venue migration

evaluation_precommitment.membership_effect: NONE; these optional features cannot decide baseline cohort membership or matched-control pools for the already-frozen Cohort 001 dataset
evaluation_precommitment.coverage_mask: freeze availability mask before opening outcomes for this hypothesis family
tradability_checks: capacity relative to the hypothetical position size

strategy_factory_handoff.candidate_mechanism: event-driven continuation/temporary-impact strategy conditioned on forced-flow-to-float and forced-flow-to-liquidity, with the causal clock starting at first public announcement rather than effective-date open
strategy_factory_handoff.reason_not_ready: PIT forced-flow, float/depth and implementation data have not yet been assembled into a survivorship-safe selection dataset; no after-cost strategy claim is justified.
